files.document_title: Texas Railroad Commission public GIS pipeline layer, features under Form T-4 permit 10370 whose subsystem name contains ABILENE
files.fetch_route: curl against the Railroad Commission ArcGIS REST service
files.what_it_shows: Six line features, all 24 inch, status In Service, operator Energy Transfer Company, system Pearland or Abilene. ABILENE 24IN (named 20260004 ABILENE 24IN) runs about 26.6 miles in Taylor County from about -99.901, 32.216 to -99.778, 32.510. ABILENE 20 runs about 2.3 miles in Taylor County, 7.6 miles in Jones County and 3.1 miles in Shackelford County, total about 13.0 miles. ABILENE 30 runs about 18.6 miles in Callahan County and 1.9 miles in Shackelford County, total about 20.5 miles.

files.document_title: Energy Transfer Investor Presentation, August 2026, page 11, Hugh Brinson Pipeline Project
files.what_it_shows: A statewide schematic of the Hugh Brinson mainline and Midland Lateral. Abilene is only a town label on the mainline. The laterals are not drawn. It is useful only to confirm the Phase I status and the lateral mileage statements.

files.document_title: Energy Transfer Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Presentation
files.what_it_shows: Text only for the laterals. The company says it completed another 14 mile lateral off the Hugh Brinson Pipeline in Abilene, Texas, ready for service in the second quarter of 2026.

searched: Texas Railroad Commission public GIS pipeline layers (RRC_Public_Viewer_Srvs, layers 13 and 14), queried for all Energy Transfer Company features in Taylor County, then for permit 10370 features named Abilene
Energy Transfer August 2026 investor presentation and second quarter 2026 earnings presentation, read for lateral mileage and any map
Web search for Hugh Brinson Abilene lateral route, Stargate and Crusoe supply, and Taylor County filings
notes: Vector lines exist, but which of them are the sheet's Abilene laterals is not certain. Energy Transfer says it has built two laterals: a first one already flowing gas to the data center campus near Abilene (no mileage given) and a second one of about 14 miles completed in the second quarter of 2026. Under the same permit 10370 that carries the Hugh Brinson mainline, the Railroad Commission layer holds three Abilene named 24 inch groups. The ABILENE 20 group is about 13.0 miles, which is close to the 14 mile figure, but ABILENE 24IN (26.6 miles) and ABILENE 30 (20.5 miles) are longer, and no source ties each one to a campus or to a lateral. A person should compare the lines against the Abilene campus location before choosing. The permit mileage in the layer (T4PERMIT_MILES) is 26.52, 2.33 plus 7.66 plus 3.08, and 18.56 plus 1.92 for these groups, matching the measured lengths. The mainline itself (for example 202600014 HB SWEETWATER TO CISCO, 42 inch) is also in the layer but is already P5092 and was not saved here. The sheet has no length for this row. The ArcGIS service page itself returns a 403 to the URL checker, but the query URL returns data.
